description: Present a UI component to the user. Select a component with `component` and provide its props inline; nest components with `children`.

component.description: The component to render. "Header": A section heading. Renders as a bold title.; "Text": A run of text. Use for paragraphs, labels, or inline copy.; "Caption": Secondary, de-emphasized text under a primary element.; "Image": An image. Provide `src` and `alt` for accessibility.; "Divider": A horizontal rule between sections.; "Fact": A label/value pair, rendered as a key followed by its value. Use for compact metadata.; "Button": A clickable button. Carries `action` describing the side effect or resume value. Set `submit` to submit an ancestor Form/Card instead of firing `action` on click.; "Select": A dropdown selector. Carries `action` describing the on-select behavior.; "Input": A text input. Carries `action` describing the on-submit behavior.; "DatePicker": A date input. Carries `action` describing the on-select behavior.; "Checkbox": A checkbox with a label. Carries `action` describing the on-change behavior.; "RadioGroup": A group of mutually exclusive radio options. Carries `action` describing the on-change behavior.; "Form": Wraps named child controls (Select/Input/Checkbox/RadioGroup/DatePicker with a `name`). Carries `action`; on submit it fires with every named control's value, keyed by `name`.; "Card": A titled section of related content, the default way to break a response into parts. It renders as plain content, so several in a row read as one answer rather than a stack of boxes; it takes on a framed surface only when `background` is set, when `confirm`/`cancel` add a footer, or when it is a slot in a `Carousel`. Set `asForm` to collect named child control values on submit.; "Col": A vertical stack; children laid out top to bottom.; "Row": A horizontal row; children laid out left to right.; "Spacer": Empty space that pushes neighbors apart.; "Badge": A small labeled tag, e.g. for status or category.; "Box": A generic container for composition, e.g. a progress bar built from an outer track Box containing a partial-width fill Box. Size, radius, and background accept arbitrary values, so they render as inline styles rather than data-attribute hooks.; "ListView": A vertical list container. Wrap `ListViewItem` children as rows.; "ListViewItem": A row inside a ListView. Carries `action` to make the whole row clickable and keyboard-activatable.; "Table": Tabular data. Provide `columns` and `rows`; each row is an array of cells matching the columns.; "Markdown": A markdown string. Rendered as-is by default; override this component for a full markdown renderer.; "Chart": A chart. `variant` selects bar, line, sparkline, or area rendering. Provide `data` for a single series, or `series` for multiple named series (`series` takes precedence over `data` when both are present). Set `stacked` to accumulate series values instead of overlaying them, and `showAxis`/`showLegend` to add y-axis ticks, x-axis point labels, and a legend.; "Alert": A highlighted message conveying urgency. `tone` drives the severity.; "Carousel": A horizontally scrollable group of `Card` children (max 10). Set `label` for an accessible name.; "Icon": A small line icon from the built-in set. `size` controls the rendered pixel size.

key.description: Stable identity for this UI node. Use it for list items that may reorder.

round.description: Render as a circular avatar (fully rounded, cropped to a square).

flush.description: Whether the divider spans the full width with no inset.

block.description: Whether the button spans the full width.

submit.description: Render as a submit button for an ancestor Form/Card instead of a click button.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown when nothing is selected.

name.description: Field name used inside a Form.

multiline.description: Render a textarea instead of a single-line input.

gap.description: Gap between children in 4px units. 0 to 8 is the supported range.

padding.description: Padding in 4px units (e.g. 2 = 8px). 0 to 8 is the supported range.

background.description: Background color or gradient (any CSS background value). Setting this also switches the card's own text to white, since a custom background makes the card a tinted surface; children can still opt into a different color explicitly.

asForm.description: Render as a form; submitting it fires `confirm.action` with every named child control's value, keyed by `name`.

confirm.description: Confirm button shown in the footer.

action.description: Action fired when the button is activated.

type.description: The action type, resolved by the host's action registry.

cancel.description: Cancel button shown in the footer.

action.description: Action fired when the button is activated.

type.description: The action type, resolved by the host's action registry.

radius.description: Corner radius; "full" is a pill/circle, a number is pixels.

data.description: Data points for a single series.

series.description: Multiple named series; takes precedence over `data` when present.

label.description: Series label, shown in the legend.

stacked.description: Accumulate series values instead of overlaying them (bar and area variants; ignored for line and sparkline).

showAxis.description: Show y-axis ticks and x-axis point labels.

showLegend.description: Show a legend mapping each series to its color.
